newsitem.title: USA: Mallinckrodt seeks European marketing nod.
newsitem.headline: Mallinckrodt seeks European marketing nod.

text.p: Mallinckrodt Inc and Molecular Biosystems Inc said Thursday they jointly filed an application seeking authorization to market FS069, Molecular Biosystems' second-generation ultrasound imaging agent, in Europe.
FS069 is designed to enhance ultrasound imaging by enabling physicians to visualize blood flow and enhance resolution of anatomical structure where ultrasound alone is inadequate.

Molecular Biosystems, based in San Diego, Calif., develops and manufactures ultrasound contrast agents for medical imaging. Mallinckrodt produces analgesic pharmaceuticals, diagnostic imaging agents, medical devices, catalysts and laboratory chemicals.
